title: Comparison square for the original composition units
statement: For affine schemes X and X′, g′:X′→X and K in the derived category of X, let c and i be the selected comparisons of lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition. Let a_Y be the hom of c(Y.isoSpec.hom,Y.isoSpec.inv), transport along Y.isoSpec.hom_inv_id and i Y. The forward comparison at (derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).obj K, followed by derivedPullback X′.toSpecΓ applied to the inverse-spectrum comparison at K and then a_X′ at (derivedPullback g′).obj K, equals (derivedPullback g′).map(a_X at K). This statement uses the original composition units, without an equivalence or adjointification.

source.place: Lemma on composition of derived pullbacks; Second step of the parent proof: apply composition associativity and the two unit laws to the spectrum square

proof.text: Expand the forward and inverse affine comparisons into selected composition comparisons and equality transports. Identify isoSpec.hom with toSpecΓ while transporting the inverse-pair comparisons to the same identity morphism.

Use the selected associativity law on (h′,v′,g′), (h′,q,v), and (g′,h,v), where h,h′ are the spectrum maps, v,v′ their inverses, and q is Spec.map g′.appTop. Transport all triple composites to g′ using the two spectrum naturality identities and h v = id, h′ v′ = id. Replace the identity-comparison components with the transported comparisons for (id,g′) and (g′,id) using the selected unit laws.

Substitute the first associativity equation, cancel the mapped inverse comparison for (v′,g′), substitute the second equation, and cancel the inverse comparison for (h′,q). The third associativity equation proves the remaining equality. Equality transport proofs agree by proof irrelevance. These algebraic manipulations are proved in private helpers for abstract functors and then specialized to derived pullback.

theorem affineSpectrum_composition_unit_square
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X']
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
  let c : ∀ {P Q Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : P ⟶ Q) (l : Q ⟶ Z),
      derivedPullback l ⋙ derivedPullback k ≅ derivedPullback (k ≫ l) :=
    fun k l ↦ (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) k l
  let i : ∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, derivedPullback (𝟙 Y) ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))).2
  (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso g').hom.app ((derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPullback X'.toSpecΓ).map
        ((affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').hom.app K) ≫
      (c X'.isoSpec.hom X'.isoSpec.inv ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k : X' ⟶ X' ↦ derivedPullback k) X'.isoSpec.hom_inv_id) ≪≫
      i X').hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
    (derivedPullback g').map
      ((c X.isoSpec.hom X.isoSpec.inv ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ X ↦ derivedPullback k) X.isoSpec.hom_inv_id) ≪≫
      i X).hom.app K)
